verse.verse_1: By those who drag forth to destruction,
verse.verse_5: And those who govern the event,
verse.verse_6: On the day when the first trump resoundeth.
verse.verse_8: On that day hearts beat painfully
verse.verse_10: (Now) they are saying: Shall we really be restored to our first state
verse.verse_11: Even after we are crumbled bones?
verse.verse_12: They say: Then that would be a vain proceeding.
verse.verse_13: Surely it will need but one shout,
verse.verse_14: And lo! they will be awakened.
verse.verse_15: Hath there come unto thee the history of Moses?
verse.verse_16: How his Lord called him in the holy vale of Tuwa,
verse.verse_17: (Saying:) Go thou unto Pharaoh - Lo! he hath rebelled -
verse.verse_18: And say (unto him): Hast thou (will) to grow (in grace)?
verse.verse_19: Then I will guide thee to thy Lord and thou shalt fear (Him).
verse.verse_20: And he showed him the tremendous token.
verse.verse_22: Then turned he away in haste,
verse.verse_24: And proclaimed: "I (Pharaoh) am your Lord the Highest."
verse.verse_25: So Allah seized him (and made him) an example for the after (life) and for the former.
verse.verse_26: Lo! herein is indeed a lesson for him who feareth.
verse.verse_27: Are ye the harder to create, or is the heaven that He built?
verse.verse_28: He raised the height thereof and ordered it;
verse.verse_29: And He made dark the night thereof, and He brought forth the morn thereof.
verse.verse_30: And after that He spread the earth,
verse.verse_31: And produced therefrom the water thereof and the pasture thereof,
verse.verse_32: And He made fast the hills,
verse.verse_33: A provision for you and for your cattle.
verse.verse_34: But when the great disaster cometh,
verse.verse_35: The day when man will call to mind his (whole) endeavour,
verse.verse_36: And hell will stand forth visible to him who seeth,
verse.verse_37: Then, as for him who rebelled
verse.verse_38: And chose the life of the world,
verse.verse_39: Lo! hell will be his home.
verse.verse_40: But as for him who feared to stand before his Lord and restrained his soul from lust,
verse.verse_41: Lo! the Garden will be his home.
verse.verse_42: They ask thee of the Hour: when will it come to port?
verse.verse_43: Why (ask they)? What hast thou to tell thereof?
verse.verse_44: Unto thy Lord belongeth (knowledge of) the term thereof.
verse.verse_45: Thou art but a warner unto him who feareth it.
verse.verse_46: On the day when they behold it, it will be as if they had but tarried for an evening or the morn thereof.
